title: Frijoles Refritos
description: Frijoles Refritos is a dish from Mexico prepared with pinto beans, yellow onion, garlic, queso fresco. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Soak the dried beans in ample clean cold water for about 360 minutes, drain and discard the soaking water; cook fully in fresh water.
After soaking, drain the pinto beans and boil thoroughly in fresh water until tender; do not mash undercooked legumes.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 11 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 10 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
